prompt: Our Qdrant cluster RAM keeps growing even though we stopped ingesting data a week ago. We're getting alerts at 80% memory (3.24GB of 4GB). When we restart the cluster, memory drops back down immediately. Is this a memory leak?

assertions.text: Explains this is likely OS page cache, not a memory leak
Distinguishes between actual data RAM and page cache
Explains why restart drops memory (flushes cache)
Recommends checking Qdrant metrics for actual data vs cache breakdown
Does NOT immediately jump to 'enable quantization' as the fix
Mentions upgrading to latest version if slow growth persists
